raw_description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: EST

About the Company

Our client is a growth-focused marketing partner that helps DTC and B2B brands scale through data-driven marketing, performance advertising, retention, e-commerce, and profitability-focused strategies. Their services include paid media across Google and Meta, email and SMS marketing, business intelligence, e-commerce development, and fractional CMO leadership. They work closely with growing brands to improve revenue, customer acquisition, ROAS, and overall profitability.

About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Email Marketing Strategist to help execute and optimize email campaigns that drive revenue, retention, and customer engagement.

Working closely with senior strategists, you'll support campaign execution, email flows, segmentation, QA, and performance reporting. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who wants hands-on experience in Klaviyo, lifecycle marketing, automation, and performance-driven email strategy.

Responsibilities

- Build, QA, schedule, and deploy email campaigns using Klaviyo or similar ESPs.
- Support weekly and monthly email campaign calendars.
- Assist with building and optimizing flows such as welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, and win-back.
- Monitor campaign and flow performance and identify basic optimization opportunities.
- Track metrics including open rate, click rate, conversion rate, and revenue.
- Pull performance reports and summarize key insights.
- Support A/B testing of subject lines, messaging, creative, and other campaign elements.
- Assist with audience segmentation and personalization based on customer behavior.
- Collaborate with the team to align email messaging with SMS and other marketing channels.
- Maintain strong attention to detail across campaign setup, links, formatting, targeting, and QA.

Competencies and Qualifications
Must-Have

- 0-2 years of experience in email marketing, digital marketing, e-commerce, or a related field.
- Basic familiarity with Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar email marketing platforms.
- Understanding of email marketing fundamentals, including campaigns vs. flows.
- Strong attention to detail, particularly in campaign QA and execution.
- Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, and basic performance reports.
- Strong written communication and organizational skills.
- Willingness to learn and take direction from senior strategists.

Nice-to-Have

- Hands-on experience with Klaviyo.
- Familiarity with GA4.
- Basic knowledge of segmentation, personalization, and A/B testing.
- Experience with e-commerce, DTC, or lifecycle marketing.
- Familiarity with SMS marketing.

Key Qualities

- Detail-Oriented: Ensures campaigns are accurate, properly tested, and error-free before launch.
- Analytical: Comfortable reviewing performance data and identifying basic insights.
- Organized: Can manage campaign calendars, tasks, and deadlines reliably.
- Performance-Driven: Understands that email should contribute to engagement, retention, and revenue.
- Collaborative: Works effectively with senior strategists and cross-functional team members.

What We Offer

- 100% Remote Work - Work from anywhere in the Philippines.
- Career Growth Opportunities - Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.
- Collaborative & Innovative Team - Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

Application Process

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we're here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.
